name: AdGuard Home
author: Netlens
description: Registers your devices in AdGuard Home as DNS rewrites (Filters, DNS rewrites): an A record for every device Netlens knows and DNS does not, and a changed address for devices whose IP changed (DHCP). Netlens only changes rewrites it wrote itself (it remembers them, AdGuard Home has no comment field) and never touches rewrites you or anything else made.

config.label: AdGuard Home servers
config.help: Every AdGuard Home that should carry the records. AdGuard Home has one kind of login, so use a user of its own (in AdGuardHome.yaml under users:) rather than your everyday admin.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Only relevant for https addresses. Turn it off for a self-signed certificate.
